CRI / LIDOCAINE

Lidocaine CRI

CAT SELECTED — LIDOCAINE CRI DISABLED

No feline dose, preparation volume or pump rate is provided. Cats are more sensitive to lidocaine’s cardiovascular and central nervous system effects. This tool does not support feline lidocaine CRIs.

All lidocaine CRI controls and rate selections are disabled. Confirm the intended drug and patient species with the treating veterinarian. Clinical reference.

Uses the shared species and weight above. Workbook profiles & clinical references.

Best use: Canine adjunct analgesia; reassess pain and cardiovascular status. Feline use is disabled in this tool. Veterinary reference.

Prepare an infusion

Canine analgesic reference: 20–50 mcg/kg/min; select the prescribed dose.

Run time changes the amount prepared, not the prescribed dose. Changing the pump input calculates a new preparation; it does not titrate an existing syringe. Duration is nominal before priming/discard.

More info · concentration reference

Concentration reference

Stock: 2% = 20 mg/mL. Workbook preparation options: 10 or 20 mg/mL. Use an appropriate plain injectable formulation without epinephrine; verify suitability for IV infusion. These options are not universal veterinary maximums. Feline CRIs remain disabled.

Stock is the vial concentration; prepared concentration is what reaches the pump. Verify the actual vial and local preparation protocol.
